original_test_intent: Verify that the intended board FRU contains the approved board assembly part number and revision and that the authoritative BMC UI/OEM inventory reports the same component identity.
original_method: Bind the board FRU and UI/API component resource, securely retrieve raw part-number values, apply only approved formatting and revision rules, and compare them with the versioned board BOM/assembly record.
manual_activity: Supply the board BOM part number/revision, component-location mapping and approved normalization policy; no physical action or mutation is required.
required_inputs: Authoritative board assembly part number and revision
Approved punctuation, whitespace and revision-suffix policy
safety_requirements: Use read-only FRU and API operations
Never write FRU or issue raw mutation/PATCH/board control
Do not substitute chassis PN or product name
Preserve raw part-number and revision tokens
Do not strip revision suffixes without approval
Stop on multiple board records or location ambiguity
agent_execution_scope: Bind the intended FRU to a component location
Resolve the validated OEM/UI board resource
Capture complete redacted responses and statuses
Compare with the board BOM oracle
Report exact mismatch or unresolved revision
engineer_actions: Supply the expected board PN and revision
Resolve stale BOM or replacement-board discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `ipmitool fru print` may list the board PN, but `/Chassis/system` and `.Board.PartNumber` are not validated and may refer to another component. A missing-path fallback and raw string view do not prove BOM revision correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secure read-only access to capture the location-bound board FRU and validated OEM/UI component property, preserve raw PN/revision values and compare them with the approved board BOM under explicit formatting rules.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The `ipmitool fru list` inspection, Board Part Number field, UI agreement criterion and 2/0-minute timing are preserved; board instance, endpoint, BOM and revision rules are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a component-aware comparator that records board location, FRU/resource IDs, raw PN/revision tokens, BOM revision and normalization-policy version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds board-instance provenance and revision-aware BOM validation rather than relying on visual comparison of an assumed property.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong board assembly and revision while retaining the intended read-only FRU/UI cross-check.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Part-number suffixes can encode hardware changes; treating them as decoration can incorrectly accept an incompatible board.

project_override_considerations: Board Part Number is separate from Chassis Part Number and Board Product. The unavailable private scripts cannot be assumed to collapse or map these identities.
expected_evidence: Selected FRU and OEM/UI component resource
Complete redacted raw responses and statuses
Raw board PN and revision tokens
No hardware PASS claim by the agent

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and prior reviews consistently target the board part number. Missing component binding, endpoint and BOM rules are execution gaps, not conflicting source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The board assembly identity and comparison are clear. The exact BOM, resource mapping and revision policy are finite project packages.

review_improvement: Prevents the chassis PN, product label, wrong board record or stripped revision from being accepted as proof of the installed board assembly identity.
independent_technical_reasoning: Board Part Number identifies a particular assembly, often with suffixes that encode revision or option content. Matching only a base token can miss a hardware incompatibility, while selecting the wrong FRU among several boards can yield a plausible but irrelevant value. The comparison therefore needs physical/component location, exact raw tokens and a versioned BOM rule. These are package prerequisites for an otherwise read-only operation, so REQUIRES is appropriate.
